title: Agraphis Nutans
text: This is a very useful remedy in cases of catarrhal conditions, especially of the nose and throat. It is indicated in children with enlarged tonsils and adenoids. There is a general tendency to take cold easily. Chronic catarrh of the nose. Obstruction of the nose. Sneezing. Enlarged tonsils and adenoids. Throat feels swollen and sore. Hawking of mucus. Deafness from catarrh of the Eustachian tube. Otorrhoea. Compare: Hydrastis; Calcarea phosphorica; Silicea. Third to sixth potency.
